Uber combines Mobility, Delivery and Freight. The reviewed v2 package supports a dated conditional model; the separate independent review closes the numerical/source-treatment review only. It does not certify economic assumptions, current capitalization or funding. Bear, base and bull cases have no assigned probabilities.

Bookings are customer transaction volume, not Uber revenue. Revenue/bookings ratios reflect principal-versus-agent accounting and segment mix, not a uniform take rate. UK Mobility changed to principal accounting in 2022 and reversed to agency in 2026. The TTM June anchor is FY2025 + H1 2026 − H1 2025. Forecasts are ten July–June years, ending 2027–2036.

GAAP EBIT retains recurring SBC and expensed R&D. SBC is treated as economic cash replacement: no addback or second future-issuance schedule. Existing earned awards and option claims are separate. Investment gains and nonoperating tax benefits do not become operating earnings.

Net investment = gross operating asset reinvestment − operating D&A + noninsurance NWC change + collateral increase − insurance reserve increase. Restricted cash and investments are a collateral proxy, not verified exclusively insurance. The base case requires 100% collateral backing and catches up the opening USD1,493m gap in year 1. The pool and reserve are not added or deducted again in the equity bridge.

Editing revenue scales that year’s reviewed Mobility, Delivery and Freight bookings proportionally, retaining reviewed segment mix and revenue/bookings ratios. EBIT margin is converted to EBIT/bookings margin. Editing net investment solves the residual gross asset budget after D&A, NWC and insurance/collateral funding; a negative budget is invalid. Later-year revenue remains independently editable.

Conditional equity allocation is not a cash-funding certificate. Daily liquidity, covenant capacity, local cash fungibility and pending acquisition funding remain unverified. The December 2026 term-loan maturity and expired unused capacity are flagged without duplicate valuation deductions.

USD WACC, terminal growth, terminal ROIC and operating paths are editable analyst assumptions, not market-calibrated forecasts. Annual WACCs compound for discounting. The optional October bridge uses the selected source-scenario WACC for interim accrual, shown separately from edited annual and terminal rates.

Normalized cash tax applies to positive EBIT, with no loss benefit. Deferred tax assets and NOL optionality are not separate equity additions. Historical headline tax rates reflect nonoperating effects and are not forecast cash tax rates.

Terminal flows retain operating D&A, gross reinvestment, noninsurance NWC and insurance/collateral growth. Net reinvestment is at least NOPAT × growth / terminal ROIC; any required top-up is deducted. Terminal WACC and ROIC must exceed growth. The ten-year June origin is fixed.

Default June allocation is unselected. Load the explicit illustration or enter every required amount; unknown is never zero. Investment values, earned awards, option claims, lease claims, NCI, tax/litigation provisions and vehicle commitments are analyst choices, not verified fair values. June reported shares are rounded to a thousand; shares use actual counts, while monetary inputs use USD millions.

Optional October rollforward keeps economic FCFF separate from actual cash, retained euro cash separate from converted/spent proceeds, and each deal’s EV, investments, acquired cash and claims separate. September euro-note principal EUR4,500m, gross proceeds EUR4,489.3075m and underwriting EUR24.875m are sourced; only other expenses remain a choice. Approximate net proceeds EUR4,453m are not verified realized cash. Pending Delivery Hero and ezCater are not automatically consolidated or funded.

2016–2025 is source history, not ten comparable audited years. 2016 is partial unaudited selected-data history with missing CFO/capex, retained as unknown. Recast revenue is USD3,338m for 2016 and USD7,402m for 2017, superseding old presentations. ASC606, ASC842, IPO SBC, pandemic, acquisitions/disposals, UK accounting changes and the 2026 segment profit measure limit comparisons. CFO less capex is not unlevered FCFF.

Monte Carlo runs only when you press Run. Defaults are fixed; no probability distribution is calibrated. Edited operating paths preserve the Uber cash-flow formulas and terminal reinvestment floor. Simulation exposes June operating EV only, never a per-share or current-target distribution; claims, allocation and October rollforward are not sampled.

sourceInputs.discount_convention: annual end-of-period; full annual July-June buckets; terminal at 2036-06-30
sourceInputs.not_ex_ante: Information learned after June informs this June-anchored sensitivity exercise. It is not a contemporaneous June trade recommendation.

policies.future_sbc: GAAP EBIT is after recurring labor cost including SBC, treated economically as cash replacement; no SBC addback and no second future-share issuance schedule. Existing earned award claims require separate opt-in allocation.
policies.rd: Expensed inside GAAP EBIT; no R&D capitalization/addback.
policies.capex: gross_reinvestment_revenue_ratio is an assumed total operating replacement/growth asset budget, above reported cash PP&E capex and inclusive of new finance-leased asset funding; not a mechanical historical capex extrapolation. No acquired-business earnings or acquisition financing included.
policies.insurance: Reserve stock linked to Mobility bookings; restricted cash+investments is a collateral proxy, not verified exclusively insurance. FCFF includes increase in reserve less increase in required collateral. Base assumes100% backing, forcing opening1493 gap catch-up into year1. Pool and reserve are not then separately credited/subtracted in bridge.
policies.other_nwc: Incremental noninsurance NWC is chosen fraction of revenue increase. Excludes insurance/collateral, cash, investments, debt and leases; ordinary payables assumed maintained. Legacy exceptional liabilities have separate bridge reserves.
policies.tax: Normalized cash tax rates apply to positive operating EBIT from year1 and terminal. No tax benefit on losses. Deferred tax assets and NOL optionality are deliberately not added to equity.
policies.leases: Operating rent retained in EBIT; operating lease debt not separately subtracted. Finance-lease funding included in gross operating reinvestment; existing finance-lease liability deducted once in equity bridge.
policies.terminal: Compute full next-year flows then enforce terminal net reinvestment at least NOPAT*g/terminal_ROIC; deduct incremental top-up if ordinary net reinvestment including insurance funding is lower. No terminal SBC/insurance free lunch.
policies.scope: June operating perimeter only. Includes SpotHero acquired April2026 already in H1 but no separate speculative acquisition growth. Excludes post-June acquisitions/financing unless explicit rollforward supplied.

rollforwardTemplate.known_event_rules: September notes:4500 EURm principal,4489.3075 EURm sourced gross proceeds,10.6925 EURm fixed original issue discount. Known underwriting discounts24.875 EURm reduce issuer proceeds before other expenses to4464.4325 EURm; only other expenses require assumption. Getir465 USDm cash covers controlled food business plus minority grocery investment; separate values required. Careem prior investment removal derives from selected June allocation.

latest_exact_observed_shares.warning: Not an October share count; explicitly roll forward.

rollforwardTemplate.cash_scope: Economic FCFF removes distributable economic value from EV. Actual operating cash is economic FCFF plus the five explicit reconciliation components. Cash interest is deducted in full separately. Other nonoperating cash includes investment sales/purchases, option/ESPP cash proceeds and other receipts/payments, excluding all separately listed items. Pair asset dispositions and dilution in their own ledgers. Positive signs add cash.
rollforwardTemplate.currency_scope: Retained EUR amount is a subset of net note proceeds still held in EUR at October19; current FX revalues that cash. Converted/spent proceeds are translated initially at issue FX, with explicit realized FX adjustment. Other currency cash translation is separate.
rollforwardTemplate.claim_scope: Every inherited nondebt claim is an explicit current valuation assumption, excluding per-deal new NCI. The current debt price fraction includes all current note claim value including accrued interest. Never use a cash payment to automatically release an unrelated claim. New deal-specific finance leases, litigation/tax or other noncommon obligations go in each deal other_claim_value_added, separate from inherited claims.

issuer_note_proceeds_estimate_reference.rule: May explicitly choose11.4325 as estimated other expenses, not a verified realized outflow; known underwriting24.875 is already fixed in engine and must not be entered again.

scope.en: June 30, 2026 operating EV using information through October 19. June per-share allocation requires explicit investment, claim, tax, lease and award assumptions. October cash, claims and exact shares remain unknown. No current target, quote comparison, recommendation or historical backtest is supplied.
scope.zh-Hans: 采用截至十月十九日信息的 2026 年六月三十日经营企业价值。六月每股条件分配需要明确投资、请求权、税、租赁及奖励假设。十月现金、请求权及准确股数仍未知。不提供当前目标价、报价比较、投资建议或历史回测。

summary.en: Uber combines Mobility, Delivery and Freight. The reviewed v2 package supports a dated conditional model; the separate independent review closes the numerical/source-treatment review only. It does not certify economic assumptions, current capitalization or funding. Bear, base and bull cases have no assigned probabilities.
summary.zh-Hans: 优步包含出行、配送及货运业务。已复核 v2 支持指定日期条件模型；独立复核仅完成数值与来源处理检查，并不认证经济假设、当前资本结构或融资能力。熊、基准、牛情景未赋予概率。

growth.en: Bookings are customer transaction volume, not Uber revenue. Revenue/bookings ratios reflect principal-versus-agent accounting and segment mix, not a uniform take rate. UK Mobility changed to principal accounting in 2022 and reversed to agency in 2026. The TTM June anchor is FY2025 + H1 2026 − H1 2025. Forecasts are ten July–June years, ending 2027–2036.
growth.zh-Hans: 订单总额是客户交易量，不是优步收入。收入／订单比率受主要责任人与代理人会计及业务组合影响，并非统一抽成率。英国出行于 2022 年转主要责任人模式，2026 年转回代理模式。六月滚动十二个月起点等于 2025 全年加 2026 上半年减 2025 上半年。预测为十个七月至六月年度，分别截至 2027–2036 年。

profitability.en: GAAP EBIT retains recurring SBC and expensed R&D. SBC is treated as economic cash replacement: no addback or second future-issuance schedule. Existing earned awards and option claims are separate. Investment gains and nonoperating tax benefits do not become operating earnings.
profitability.zh-Hans: 美国准则营业利润保留经常性股份薪酬及费用化研发。股份薪酬视为经济现金替代，不加回也不重复计入未来发行。已赚取奖励及期权请求权另行处理。投资收益与非经营税收利益不计入营业利润。

capital.en: Net investment = gross operating asset reinvestment − operating D&A + noninsurance NWC change + collateral increase − insurance reserve increase. Restricted cash and investments are a collateral proxy, not verified exclusively insurance. The base case requires 100% collateral backing and catches up the opening USD1,493m gap in year 1. The pool and reserve are not added or deducted again in the equity bridge.
capital.zh-Hans: 净投资等于经营资产总再投资减经营折旧摊销，加非保险营运资本变化与抵押品增加，再减保险准备金增加。受限现金及投资只是抵押品代理，并未确认全部属于保险。基准情景要求百分之百抵押覆盖，并在第一年补足期初 14.93 亿美元缺口。权益桥接不再重复加减该资金池及准备金。

mapping.en: Editing revenue scales that year’s reviewed Mobility, Delivery and Freight bookings proportionally, retaining reviewed segment mix and revenue/bookings ratios. EBIT margin is converted to EBIT/bookings margin. Editing net investment solves the residual gross asset budget after D&A, NWC and insurance/collateral funding; a negative budget is invalid. Later-year revenue remains independently editable.
mapping.zh-Hans: 编辑收入会按比例调整该年已复核的出行、配送及货运订单，保留业务组合及收入／订单比率。营业利润率换算为营业利润／订单比率。编辑净投资会在折旧摊销、营运资本及保险抵押资金后推导剩余资产总预算；负预算无效。后续年度收入可独立编辑。

funding.en: Conditional equity allocation is not a cash-funding certificate. Daily liquidity, covenant capacity, local cash fungibility and pending acquisition funding remain unverified. The December 2026 term-loan maturity and expired unused capacity are flagged without duplicate valuation deductions.
funding.zh-Hans: 条件权益分配不等于现金融资认证。每日流动性、契约容量、当地现金可调度性及待完成收购资金仍未核实。2026 年十二月定期贷款到期及已失效未用额度单独标示，不重复扣减估值。

wacc.en: USD WACC, terminal growth, terminal ROIC and operating paths are editable analyst assumptions, not market-calibrated forecasts. Annual WACCs compound for discounting. The optional October bridge uses the selected source-scenario WACC for interim accrual, shown separately from edited annual and terminal rates.
wacc.zh-Hans: 美元资本成本、终值增长、终值投入资本回报率及经营路径均为可编辑分析假设，未经市场校准。年度资本成本复合折现。可选十月桥接使用所选来源情景资本成本进行期间增值，与编辑后的年度及终值利率分别展示。

tax.en: Normalized cash tax applies to positive EBIT, with no loss benefit. Deferred tax assets and NOL optionality are not separate equity additions. Historical headline tax rates reflect nonoperating effects and are not forecast cash tax rates.
tax.zh-Hans: 标准化现金税适用于正营业利润，不给予亏损税收利益。递延所得税资产及亏损结转选择权不另加到权益。历史表面税率含非经营影响，并非预测现金税率。

terminal.en: Terminal flows retain operating D&A, gross reinvestment, noninsurance NWC and insurance/collateral growth. Net reinvestment is at least NOPAT × growth / terminal ROIC; any required top-up is deducted. Terminal WACC and ROIC must exceed growth. The ten-year June origin is fixed.
terminal.zh-Hans: 终值现金流保留经营折旧摊销、总再投资、非保险营运资本及保险抵押品增长。净再投资至少为税后营业利润乘增长率除终值投入资本回报率；所需追加投资予以扣除。终值资本成本及回报率必须高于增长率。六月起点与十年期限固定。

claims.en: Default June allocation is unselected. Load the explicit illustration or enter every required amount; unknown is never zero. Investment values, earned awards, option claims, lease claims, NCI, tax/litigation provisions and vehicle commitments are analyst choices, not verified fair values. June reported shares are rounded to a thousand; shares use actual counts, while monetary inputs use USD millions.
claims.zh-Hans: 默认六月分配未选择。可载入明确示例或输入全部所需金额；未知绝不等于零。投资价值、已赚取奖励、期权、租赁、少数股权、税务诉讼拨备及车辆承诺均为分析选择，并非经核实公允价值。六月报告股数四舍五入至千股；股数使用实际数量，金额使用百万美元。

financing.en: Optional October rollforward keeps economic FCFF separate from actual cash, retained euro cash separate from converted/spent proceeds, and each deal’s EV, investments, acquired cash and claims separate. September euro-note principal EUR4,500m, gross proceeds EUR4,489.3075m and underwriting EUR24.875m are sourced; only other expenses remain a choice. Approximate net proceeds EUR4,453m are not verified realized cash. Pending Delivery Hero and ezCater are not automatically consolidated or funded.
financing.zh-Hans: 可选十月滚动将经济自由现金流与实际现金、保留欧元现金与已兑换或使用资金、各收购的企业价值、投资、取得现金及请求权分别处理。九月欧元债本金 45 亿、总收入 44.893075 亿及承销费 2487.5 万欧元有来源；仅其他费用需选择。约 44.53 亿欧元净收入并非已核实实际现金。待完成的 Delivery Hero 与 ezCater 不会自动合并或融资。

history.en: 2016–2025 is source history, not ten comparable audited years. 2016 is partial unaudited selected-data history with missing CFO/capex, retained as unknown. Recast revenue is USD3,338m for 2016 and USD7,402m for 2017, superseding old presentations. ASC606, ASC842, IPO SBC, pandemic, acquisitions/disposals, UK accounting changes and the 2026 segment profit measure limit comparisons. CFO less capex is not unlevered FCFF.
history.zh-Hans: 2016–2025 是来源历史，并非十个可比审计年度。2016 为部分未经审计选定数据，经营现金流及资本开支缺失并保留未知。重列收入为 2016 年 33.38 亿及 2017 年 74.02 亿美元，替代旧列报。收入与租赁准则、上市股份薪酬、疫情、收购处置、英国会计变化及 2026 年业务利润指标限制可比性。经营现金流减资本开支不等于无杠杆自由现金流。

uncertainty.en: Monte Carlo runs only when you press Run. Defaults are fixed; no probability distribution is calibrated. Edited operating paths preserve the Uber cash-flow formulas and terminal reinvestment floor. Simulation exposes June operating EV only, never a per-share or current-target distribution; claims, allocation and October rollforward are not sampled.
uncertainty.zh-Hans: 蒙特卡洛仅在点击运行时执行。默认输入固定，未校准概率分布。编辑的经营路径保留优步现金流公式及终值再投资下限。模拟仅显示六月经营企业价值，不显示每股或当前目标价分布；请求权、分配及十月滚动不参与抽样。
